free_tier.stated: one free account unlocks the IP2Location LITE (up to DB11: country, region, city, latitude, longitude, ZIP code, time zone), IP2Proxy LITE and ASN LITE databases, updated monthly, in BIN, CSV and MMDB
free_tier.notes: local lookups are not metered; the download itself is expected once a month

per_object_cap.stated: DB11 LITE IPv4: BIN 92.26 MB, CSV 328.53 MB (2,965,251 rows), MMDB 85.25 MB; IPv6: BIN 220.36 MB, CSV 855.89 MB; current version 01 November 2026
per_object_cap.notes: unverified: behind a sign-up: the byte size of each file served by a token download

interface_detail: HTTPS file download with the account's download token, through the IP2Location download client (download.pl -package DB11LITE -token TOKEN) or wget and curl
tooling: the IP2Location download client, wget or curl, IP2Location BIN libraries, any MMDB reader
chaining: a monthly download of DB11 LITE gives city-level lookups locally with no request meter, and the same account adds IP2Proxy LITE and ASN LITE; the hosted API is the separate IP2Location.io record. Bulk path: the monthly LITE downloads

limits.value: download once a month, on a random day in the first week; accounts with massive downloads or shared accounts are disabled

binding_note: lookups are local and unmetered, so the only constraint is the monthly download rhythm and the account-disable rule on massive downloads

identity_cost.detail: an IP2Location account: name, email address, a password of 8 or more characters with a confirmation field and a required agreement checkbox, or Google or GitHub sign-up

reliability_note: a LITE account is disabled when account sharing or massive download is detected; LITE accuracy is stated as 98 percent at country and 60 percent at city level
confidence_note: the LITE landing pages, the DB11 page, the LITE FAQ and the registration form were quoted on 2026-10-30. No account was opened, so no file was downloaded; a token download would move it to measured.
